state: Their not-yet-run wording describes the frozen pre-run plan, not the final exit state.
scheduler_correction: scientific_worker_started=false is a historical scheduler handoff/metadata snapshot; it does not assert the final runtime state. summary, exitcode and index_completed establish one worker completed.

read_only_collector_failure.error: AssertionError while assuming the controller was still queued
read_only_collector_failure.resolution: The one worker had already naturally finished; subsequent full summary and final INDEX collection confirm exit0.

plan_schema_precision_note: F32 field/warped/residual/gradient_fsl, bool mask, F64 coefficients/bases/weights/gradients. All actual array shapes/dtypes/strides are in raw summary; points are mixed coefficient and intensity units.
index_update_order_note: Other FNIT tasks updated INDEX between registration and completion. The final updater reread under all six locks and preserved other fields; intermediate INDEX hashes are historical snapshots.
serialization_layout_scope: Array strides in the raw summary describe views before np.savez. Stage1 verified file identity, not np.load layout reconstruction. Nonstandard layouts require a separate explicit restore and validation gate in stage2.
